header.mastheadTitle: What is printed on the package is what is in the database.
header.mastheadLead: An evidence-first, zero-judgment open database for global industrial packaged foods. Every record strictly distinguishes declared label values, deterministic 100g/100ml conversions (ƒ), and regulatory upper bounds (<).
header.langToggleTitle: Switch Language / 切换界面语言

search.placeholder: Search GTIN, product name, brand, ingredient, INS…
search.emptyFilterLead: No products match the active filter combination. Try relaxing exclusions, adjusting numeric rules, or clearing filters.
search.excludeAllergensHint: Excludes products whose label declares 'contains' or 'may contain' for the selected allergens. Based on transcribed label text only; no declaration does not mean the allergen is absent. Always check the physical package.
search.mixedEvidenceTitle: Most photo submissions: {high} · Other active variant: {low}

empty.title: Database Ready (0 Product Records)
empty.lead: This database only admits real industrial packaged food records backed by cropped label photos or CC0 official registries—never fictional placeholder samples. Use OPF in two ways:
empty.step1Desc: Search above by product name, brand, or barcode, or tap the Scan button to scan a product barcode or QR code and filter objective nutrition and ingredient records.
empty.step2Title: 2. Install the opf Skill in Your AI Agent
empty.step2Desc: Ask your Agent before you buy—even for products not yet indexed here, snapping the label lets it break down nutrition facts, ingredients, and additives on the spot.

detail.legendBound: < 1.79 = Regulatory zero-rounding upper bound (click to inspect)
detail.formulaPrompt: Click any value marked with ƒ or < above to inspect its exact conversion formula.
detail.noNotes: No rounding artifacts or basis conversion flags
detail.apiFullDesc: Full (All editions, revision log, AST & provenance)
detail.redirectNotice: ⇄ Automatically redirected from consolidated edition {from} to {to}
detail.divergentOverviewLead: Multiple active core formulations coexist under this product ID. Never rely on a single default when variants differ; match your physical package and select a concrete variant below.
detail.rangeWarningBanner: For cross-variant comparison only — NEVER use min/max/midpoint for dietary intake logging; select a concrete package variant (edition_id) above first.
detail.uniformBanner: ≡ Uniform across {count} active tracks: nutrition and ingredients are identical; origins and manufacturers are shown as a deduplicated union.
detail.inactiveBanner: ⊘ Currently no active in-market edition; showing archived historical edition below.
detail.mixedBasisNotice: Active variants use mixed bases (100g vs 100ml); cross-variant nutrient ranges are omitted. Select a concrete variant above.
detail.tActiveVintage: Latest package vintage seen: {ym} (formulation may have changed since)

corroborated.label: 2+ contributors uploaded photos
corroborated.desc: Label photos were uploaded under ≥2 contributor accounts sharing the same core_fingerprint (does not guarantee distinct people or manual checking against photos)

verified.label: 1 label photo submitted
verified.desc: Includes 1 cropped label photo submission with SHA-256 hash; does not mean transcribed fields were checked against the photo or guarantee safety

official_registry_imported.label: From public official registry
official_registry_imported.desc: From official public documents or registry data; no label photo

community_reported.label: Text report only (no photo)
community_reported.desc: Text and structured fields recorded without accompanying label photos

scanner.openTitle: Scan product barcode or QR code
scanner.title: Scan Product Barcode or QR Code
scanner.subtitle: All image detection and parsing run locally in your browser—no image uploads and no external lookup APIs. Supports EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC, Code-128, QR, GS1 Digital Link, and opf: IDs.
scanner.cameraStandby: Click "Start Rear Camera" below to scan live, choose a local photo, or paste/enter a code manually.
scanner.manualLabel: Enter or paste barcode / QR payload
scanner.manualPlaceholder: Enter 8–14 digits, gtin:..., GS1 Digital Link URL, or opf:...
scanner.insecureContext: Camera access requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost). You can still pick a local image or enter/paste the code below.
scanner.unsupportedDetector: This browser does not support native BarcodeDetector image decoding. Please enter or paste the barcode/text below, or try a browser with BarcodeDetector support.
scanner.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera permission denied or no camera available; media tracks released. Please choose a photo or enter the code manually below.
scanner.cameraError: Unable to start camera ({reason}); media resources released. Please choose a photo or enter the code manually.
scanner.scanningImage: Detecting barcode or QR code locally from image…
scanner.noBarcodeInImage: No valid barcode or QR code was detected in the selected image. Try a sharper crop or enter the code manually.
scanner.imageError: Failed to read or scan image: {reason}
scanner.emptyInput: Please enter or paste a barcode, URL, or text first.
scanner.invalidCheckDigit: GS1 Mod-10 check digit failed ({digits}): rejected as an invalid GTIN barcode without querying.
scanner.plainTextNotice: No valid GTIN or opf: ID detected; populated the search box with "{text}" for text search.
scanner.directHitDesc: Retrieved product record directly from static endpoint {path} and updated the search filter.
scanner.notFoundDesc: Both the catalog index and static endpoint {path} returned 404. Copy the canonical ID below or ask an AI Agent with the opf Skill to inspect your label photos.
